articles.summary: BrazeAI Operator™ Connect, now available in limited Beta, brings BrazeAI Operator™ into the agentic tools and internal platforms where your team already works, so you can analyze performance, build campaigns, Canvases, and segments, and get the answers you need, grounded in your own Braze workspace.
articles.title: Bring Braze Intelligence into the Tools You Already Use with Operator Connect
